metadata.description: Le skill della Prompt Library di CH Labs e il plugin vocale bazinga per Claude Code.

plugins.name: tutte-le-skill
plugins.description: All 21 skills of the CH Labs Prompt Library in one install.

plugins.name: 007-founders-nations
plugins.description: Finds each founder's country of nationality, birth or upbringing and backs every claim with a verbatim quote in a ledger. Use when asking where the founders of companies or tools come from.

plugins.name: 007-headquarters-cities
plugins.description: Lists up to three main headquarters as City (Country) in rank order, each backed by a verbatim quote from the company's own pages. Use when asking where a company or tool is based.

plugins.name: 3d-decoration-asset
plugins.description: Builds 3D and animated web assets from a reference image or a prompt, with paid cloud generation only after cost approval. Use when a site needs a cursor-following mascot, a scroll sequence or a GLB model.

plugins.name: decorazione-futurista-editoriale
plugins.description: Estranges a page's form to a 0 to 100 level of essential futurism, drawn from Marinetti's manifestos, while every word stays legible. Use when a page looks generic or when brainstorming visual effects.

plugins.name: optimize-crawler-access
plugins.description: Finds and fixes what stops AI crawlers from reading a site, from robots.txt to edge blocks and JavaScript-only content. Use when ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity should cite a site, or to block training bots.

plugins.name: transcribe-audio-video
plugins.description: Transcribes speech from a local audio or video file with Voxtral 3 through OpenRouter, with optional timestamps and a per-file cost guard. Use when a task needs the words of a recording, meeting or podcast.

plugins.name: benchmark-letterario-llm
plugins.description: Asks ten questions on literary culture, bibliographies and critical judgment, first without and then with web search. Use when testing an LLM or comparing several models on how well they know literature.

plugins.name: design-system-refactor
plugins.description: Moves hardcoded styles into tokens and repeated UI into shared components, proving every page stays pixel-identical. Use when cleaning up a design system, theme or component library in any framework.

plugins.name: umanizza-stile-linguistico
plugins.description: Cleans tone, vocabulary and punctuation in Italian prose, then offers a second editorial pass. Use when a draft shows AI writing tics or when these style preferences should shape a new text.

plugins.name: gerarchia-tipografica-impaginazione
plugins.description: Reorganizes a page's visual hierarchy by the meaning of its texts, with the smallest change that helps reading. Use when an already written page blurs quotes, notes and sections or misplaces emphasis.

plugins.name: iai
plugins.description: Introduces IAI, the shared family identity of Tiziano and Michelangelo Boccaccini, who program agents and build businesses with AI. Use when a request needs a bio, a profile or a signature for either.

plugins.name: coordinate-metadata-saio
plugins.description: Checks a page and its site for search and AI answer engines, then implements the suggestions the user picks, starting alone or from the widget's draft. Use when running an SEO, GEO or AEO audit.

plugins.name: metadata-copy-dadastickers
plugins.description: Gives each subpage its own title, description and share-preview text, pairing plain page facts with a verbatim Dadastickers statement. Use when subpages copy the home page's metadata or have none.

plugins.name: audit-skill-pocock
plugins.description: Audits a skill or agent instructions rule by rule against Matt Pocock's writing-for-agents guidance and Theo's additions, then drafts a refactoring plan. Use when tightening a SKILL.md, AGENTS.md or prompt.

plugins.name: descrivi-idea-prodotto
plugins.description: Orders in ten blocks the page that presents a project or business idea to readers with no context, from the opening tension to the open questions. Use when writing or revising a landing page.

plugins.name: riassumi-preservando-linguaggio
plugins.description: Shortens a text in its original language by cutting only asides and digressions, keeping the author's words, their order and the thread. Use when a summary must subtract without paraphrasing.

plugins.name: addestra-comportamento-chatbot
plugins.description: Reconstructs the intention a chatbot missed in its last saved conversation and repairs the cause in the prompt, tools or code. Use when a project's chatbot answered badly, made things up or ignored a request.

plugins.name: check-stack-updates
plugins.description: Updates outdated dependencies and tools after a compatibility check, fixes failing checks and publishes only after approval. Use when upgrading one project, a batch of projects or the machine toolchain.

plugins.name: scegli-variabili-ambiente
plugins.description: Decides whether an environment variable belongs on Vercel, on Convex or on both by where the code reads it, and sets it without exposing its value. Use when adding, moving or missing a variable.

plugins.name: evaluate-voice-quality
plugins.description: Flags misread words, wrong-voice lines and drift in AI speech, and scores each voice-clone take 0-100 against the real speaker. Use when checking a generated voice track or ranking clone takes.

plugins.name: customize-metadata-widget
plugins.description: Opens a widget with Google, browser, WhatsApp and iMessage previews to pick a page's title, description and image, then hands the draft on. Use when choosing SEO titles or share previews.

plugins.name: bazinga
plugins.description: Voice mode for Claude Code: "bazinga on" reads replies aloud in your ElevenLabs voice, "bazinga off" stops it, the mic then listens for your spoken answer, and a row above the prompt shows credits and dollars spent.
